abbrev Copies := Flavor 6

structure MassFields where
  mesonThree : Copies → Copies → Spike → Label 6
  mesonFour : Copies → Copies → Spike → Label 8
  fixedThree i j M : (mesonThree i j M).val = UV.bilinear i j M 0 0
  fixedFour i j M : (mesonFour i j M).val = UV.bilinear i j M 0 0

namespace MassFields
variable (A : MassFields) (F : Massive.Fields) (i j : Copies)

def isotropic : Averaging := some fun _ => 2

def atVector (a : Axis) : Averaging := some fun b => if a=b then 1 else 2

def axial (a : Axis) : F.W := F.quotient (atVector a) 6 (A.mesonThree i j (gamma a*g5))

def polar (a : Axis) : F.W := F.quotient (atVector a) 6 (A.mesonThree i j (gamma a))

def pseudo : F.W := F.quotient isotropic 8 (A.mesonFour i j g5)

def scalar : F.W := F.quotient isotropic 8 (A.mesonFour i j 1)
end MassFields

structure Signals where
  (rg bVector : Copies → ℝ)  -- bVector=ren masses (result not input)
  (axial polar : Copies → Copies → ℝ)  -- coefficients of the true divergences
  margin : ℝ

namespace Signals
variable (C : Sequence) (s : Signals)

/-- Equally weighted least-squares fit *only off diagonal*. Include both orders. -/
def loss (b : Copies → Copies → ℝ) (u : Copies → ℝ) := ∑ i, ∑ j,
  if i=j then 0 else (b i j-u i-u j)^2

def bMass := s.bVector

structure Read : Prop where
  reach (i : Copies) : Tendsto (fun j => (C.A j).massRead 0 i) atTop (𝓝 (s.rg i : ℂ))
  room : 0 < s.margin
  signalPos (i) : s.margin ≤ s.rg i
  separated i j (h : i ≠ j) : s.margin ≤ |s.rg i - s.rg j|
  axialPaid i j (h : i ≠ j) : |s.axial i j - (s.rg i+s.rg j)| ≤ s.margin / 100
  polarPaid i j (h : i ≠ j) : |s.polar i j - (s.rg i-s.rg j)| ≤ s.margin / 100

structure Masses : Prop where
  fitted : ∀ u, loss s.axial s.bMass ≤ loss s.axial u
  unique : ∀ u, u ≠ s.bMass → loss s.axial s.bMass < loss s.axial u
  positive : ∀ i, 0 < s.bMass i
  distinct : Injective s.bMass
  signAxial i j (h : i ≠ j) : 0 < s.axial i j
  signPolar i j (h : i ≠ j) : 0 < s.polar i j * (s.bMass i - s.bMass j)

variable (F : Massive.Fields) (A : MassFields)
open MassFields

def divergence (F : Massive.Fields) (v : Axis → F.W) := ∑ a, F.partialD a (v a)

def renP (i j : Copies) : F.W := (↑(s.axial i j / (s.bMass i + s.bMass j)) : ℂ) • A.pseudo F i j

def renS (i j : Copies) : F.W := (↑(s.polar i j / (s.bMass i - s.bMass j)) : ℂ) • A.scalar F i j

def properVector (v : Axis → F.W) : Prop := ∀ a p, EuPin.IsRotation p → F.action p (v a) =
  ∑ b, (p.coord.val b a : ℂ) • v b

def properScalar (v : F.W) := ∀ p, EuPin.IsRotation p → F.action p v = v

structure Pair (i j : Copies) : Prop where
  AP (a) : A.axial F i j a ≠ 0
  VS (a) : A.polar F i j a ≠ 0
  pseudo : A.pseudo F i j ≠ 0
  scalar : A.scalar F i j ≠ 0
  pseudoFiltration : A.pseudo F i j ∈ F.level 6
  scalarFiltration : A.scalar F i j ∈ F.level 6
  APvar : properVector F (A.axial F i j)
  VSvar : properVector F (A.polar F i j)
  psVar : properScalar F (A.pseudo F i j)
  scVar : properScalar F (A.scalar F i j)
  trueA : divergence F (A.axial F i j) = (s.axial i j : ℂ) • A.pseudo F i j
  trueV : divergence F (A.polar F i j) = (s.polar i j : ℂ) • A.scalar F i j
  pcac : divergence F (A.axial F i j) = (↑(s.bMass i+s.bMass j) : ℂ) • s.renP F A i j
  vector : divergence F (A.polar F i j) = (↑(s.bMass i-s.bMass j) : ℂ) • s.renS F A i j

structure PCAC : Prop where
  axialCross i j : s.axial i j = s.axial j i
  polarCross i j : s.polar i j = - s.polar j i
  pairs i j (h : i ≠ j) : s.Pair F A i j

/-!
# Statement: common calibration of the observable system

A lattice section in local (common stencil at each horizon) cylinders. Mixing
then carried out **on the actual Run**. Jet of the transported insertion (i.e.,
look near identity at the ratio of a marked and unmarked density, including Grassmann
terms, *before* integrating that stop). This enforces normalization conditions also
for the fields defining the masses; not fitting separate unknown multiplicative
normalizations for each flavor pair.

Use the freedom of scheme in the choice of some common (all-flavor)
taper, lattice section, wave-function and block scheme etc. Coordinates here are
**unweighted**. Input physical normalization specified by the jet at `base d`, rather
than specifying sizes of counterterms needed at the cutoff. Factors from the step laws
if stripping off engineering scaling of an operator (like `L^{D/2}` per step) aren't
used here; the fields and transport-of-insertion are already in physical units. In
particular even at a positive base, asking for unit jet here specifies the physical
unit, not `a(base)^{-(d/2)}` times the unit. This reparametrizes the off-shell frames
for general base. At base zero `a=1`; this implements the scheme for the mass fields
in `work/massread.tex` (use `Label 8` for P with r=(2,…,2), `Label 6`
for A with r=(2,…,2) - e_µ). Their physics assertion is in another file.

/-- Ratio only near the identity where unmarked density is invertible. -/
def TaperHol.test (H : TaperHol) (d : ℕ) (f x : Density n 6) (J : Labels.Jet su)
    (h : ℝ) : SpinPol d :=
  let U := H.links n d J h
  Grass.adapter (H.T.spin h) (H.T.spin h) (Ring.inverse (f U) * x U)

def TaperHol.Matches (H : TaperHol) (v : Pol d) (f x : Density n 6) : Prop := ∀ J : Labels.Jet su,
  (∀ᶠ h in 𝓝 0, IsUnit (f (H.links n d J h))) ∧ Agrees (H.test d f x J) (desired v J)
end SourceRead

structure Calibration (C : Sequence) where
  sym : RawSym
  hol : Source.Hol su
  test : SourceRead.TaperHol
  stencil (d : ℕ) : Finset Cover
  localMap (d : ℕ) : Label d →ₗ[ℂ] Cylinder.Formula (stencil d) 6
  candidate (d : ℕ) (n : Side) (b : Cover) : Label d →ₗ[ℂ] Insertion n 6
  mix (d : ℕ) (v : Averaging) (i : ℕ) : Label d ≃ₗ[ℂ] Label d
  base (d : ℕ) : ℕ

namespace Calibration
variable {C : Sequence} (P : Calibration C)

local notation "B" => C.S.side

def physical {d : ℕ} (u : Averaging) (i : ℕ) (x : Label d) (b : Cover) : Insertion (B (C.R i) (C.N i)) 6 :=
  P.candidate d _ b (P.mix d u i x)

/-- Number of cutoff lattice steps per `base` bond for this normalization
(index i with N i ≥ base). -/
def samples (i d : ℕ) := (C.S.ratio (C.N i)).val / (C.S.ratio (P.base d)).val

def marker {d : ℕ} (x : Label d) (u : Averaging) (i : ℕ) := Averaging.filter u (P.samples i d) (P.physical u i x) 0

def Transported {d : ℕ} (i : ℕ) (x : Label d) (u : Averaging) : Prop :=
  ∃ f : (m : ℕ) → Density (B (C.R i) m) 6,
    f (C.N i) = (C.A i).density (C.N i) * ⇑(P.marker x u i) ∧
    (C.A i).Carried f (P.base d) ∧
    P.test.Matches x.val ((C.A i).density (P.base d)) (f (P.base d))

structure SectionLaws : Prop where
  localizes (d n b x U) : P.candidate d n b x U = places b (P.localMap d x) U
  invariant (d n b x) : Lat.Invariant (P.candidate d n b x)
  seed d x J : SourceRead.Agrees (SourceRead.onStencil P.hol (P.localMap d x) d J)
      (SourceRead.desired x.val J)
  unit (d n b) : P.candidate d n b (P.sym.unit d)=1
  pin (d n b x p s) (h : EuPin.Lifts p s) : Action.pin p s ⇑(P.candidate d n b x) =
    (P.candidate d n (s.act b) (P.sym.pin d p x))
  charge d n b x : Action.charge ⇑(P.candidate d n b x) = P.candidate d n b (P.sym.charge d x)
  flavor d n b x u : Action.flavor u ⇑(P.candidate d n b x) = P.candidate d n b (P.sym.flavor d u x)
  star d n b x a : Action.adj a ⇑(P.candidate d n b x) =
    P.candidate d n ((Signed.mirror a).act b) (P.sym.adj d a x)
  parity d n b x : Action.parity ⇑(P.candidate d n b x) =
    P.candidate d n b (P.sym.parity d x)
  mesons (d n i j) (M : Spike) (x : Label d) (h : x.val = UV.bilinear i j M 0 0) (U) :
    P.candidate d n 0 x U = ∑ s : Pinor, ∑ t : Pinor, ∑ k : Hue,
                              M s t • (bar ((0,s,k),i) * psi ((0,t,k),j))
  baryons (n i j k) (x : Label 9) (h : x.val = UV.baryon i j k) (U) :
    P.candidate 9 n 0 x U = ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm Hue, Equiv.Perm.sign σ •
      (psi ((0,i,σ 0),0) * psi ((0,j,σ 1),1) * psi ((0,k,σ 2),2))

-- Eqn systems etc. may use larger horizons only after some cutoff.
structure Mixing (d i : ℕ) : Prop where
  live : P.base d ≤ C.N i
  unit v : P.mix d v i (P.sym.unit d) = P.sym.unit d
  pin v x p s (h : EuPin.Lifts p s) : P.sym.pin d p (P.mix d v i x) =
    P.mix d (Averaging.permute s v) i (P.sym.pin d p x)
  charge v : Commute (P.sym.charge d) (P.mix d v i) -- ensure uses desired action under composition
  flavor v u : Commute (P.sym.flavor d u) (P.mix d v i)
  star v a x : P.sym.adj d a (P.mix d v i x) = P.mix d v i (P.sym.adj d a x) -- r stays
  parity v : Commute (P.sym.parity d) (P.mix d v i)
  calibration x u : P.Transported (d:=d) i x u

structure System : Prop where
  sections : P.SectionLaws
  origin {d : ℕ} (h : d ≤ 8) : P.base d = 0
  mixing (d) : ∀ᶠ i in atTop, P.Mixing d i

structure Fields where
  W : Type
  [ab : NormedAddCommGroup W]
  [space : NormedSpace ℂ W]
  level (d : ℕ) : Submodule ℂ W
  quotient (r : Averaging) (d : ℕ) : UV.Label d →ₗ[ℂ] W
  unit : W
  adj (a : Axis) : W ≃ₛₗ[starRingEnd ℂ] W
  parity : W ≃ₗ[ℂ] W
  charge : W ≃ₗ[ℂ] W
  flavor : UV.FlavorTorus →* (W ≃ₗ[ℂ] W)
  action : EuPin →* (W ≃ₗ[ℂ] W)
  partialD (a : Axis) : W →ₗ[ℂ] W
  lie (A : Ortho.Skew) : W →ₗ[ℂ] W

attribute [instance] Fields.ab Fields.space
-- scalar restriction W normed ℝ: beware diamonds
noncomputable instance (F : Fields) : NormedSpace ℝ F.W := .restrictScalars ℝ ℂ _

namespace Fields
variable {C : Sequence} (F : Fields)

def homogeneous (p : Bool) (v : F.W) := if p then F.parity v = -v else F.parity v=v

structure System (P : Calibration C) : Prop where
  identification d r : LinearMap.range (F.quotient r d) = F.level d
  finite (d) : FiniteDimensional ℂ (F.level d)
  increases : Monotone F.level
  exhaustive (x : F.W) : ∃ d, x ∈ F.level d
  units d r : F.quotient r d (P.sym.unit d) = F.unit
  commutes d r x a : F.adj a (F.quotient r d x) = F.quotient r d (P.sym.adj d a x)
  pinActs d r x p s (h : EuPin.Lifts p s) : F.action p (F.quotient r d x) =
    F.quotient (Averaging.permute s r) d (P.sym.pin d p x)
  charge d r x : F.charge (F.quotient r d x) = F.quotient r d (P.sym.charge d x)
  flavor d r x u : F.flavor u (F.quotient r d x) = F.quotient r d (P.sym.flavor d u x)
  parity d r x : F.parity (F.quotient r d x) = F.quotient r d (P.sym.parity d x)
  reflected a : Function.Involutive (F.adj a)
  folded : Function.Involutive F.parity
  doublesBack : Function.Involutive F.charge
  flavorActs (x : F.W) : Continuous fun p => F.flavor p x
  flavorTurns (u : FlavorTorus) a : Function.Commute (F.flavor u) (F.adj a)
  properActs (x : F.W) : Continuous fun p => F.action p x
  lift {d} x (h : x ∈ F.level d) p : F.action p x ∈ F.level d
  sign (p : EuPin) (h : p.coord=1) (hm : p.matrix= -1) : F.action p = F.parity
  keepFlavor (p : EuPin) u : Function.Commute (F.action p) (F.flavor u)
  infinitesimal (A : Ortho.Skew) (x : F.W) (p) (h : EuPin.Path A p) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => F.action (p t) x) (F.lie A x) 0
  derivatives (a : Axis) (d : ℕ) (x : F.W) (h : x ∈ F.level d) : F.partialD a x ∈ F.level (d+2)

abbrev Kernel := (n : ℕ) → Points n → MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : Fin n => F.W) ℂ

-- orienting divergence toward u (inflow)
local notation "Λ"=> zone F
noncomputable def jets (V:Grid c): Sour (Modes c F):= (Λ v * K V * Λ u- Λ u * K V * Λ v)* Y
lemma stream : jets R a b u v U= -jets R a b v u U:=by unfold jets; rw [← neg_mul, neg_sub]
lemma diverge : ∑ v,jets R a b u v U= K U*y-y*K U:=by
    have ht(u): (Λ u)*Y=Y*Λ u:= (commute_here a b u 1).eq; unfold jets localF; rw [←sum_mul,sum_sub_distrib, ←sum_mul, ←sum_mul, ←mul_sum,cells,one_mul,mul_one]; rw [sub_mul,mul_assoc,mul_assoc (Λ u), (amid R a b U).eq, mul_assoc] -- ht no? D*zone*Y, zone*D*Y

noncomputable def scalarProbe (X:Spike):Insertion c F:= ContinuousMap.const _ (form (localF u X a b))
lemma leanD_cont : Continuous (leanD R):= by
   change Continuous (fun V:Grid c=> Kit.choir F (bareD R.t V 0)); apply (Kit.choir_cont F).comp (f:=fun V:Grid c=> bareD R.t V 0); fun_prop
noncomputable def current : Insertion c F := ⟨fun U=> form (jets R a b u v U), by
     have hp : Continuous (jets R a b u v):= by unfold jets; have hh:=leanD_cont R; fun_prop
     exact (couples _).continuous_of_finiteDimensional.comp hp ⟩
lemma swapped : current R a b u v= -current R a b v u:=by ext1 i; change form _ = - _; rw [stream]; exact map_neg (couples _) _
lemma here (hv:¬ Contacts u v): current R a b u v=0:=ContinuousMap.ext fun U=> (congr_arg form (currents_active R a b u v U hv)).trans (map_zero (couples _))
lemma probe_bare (p:Bool)(T:Sour (Modes c F)): applyMark p T (R.density U)= R.density U*form (if p then T*R.D U else R.D U*T):=by rw [Regulator.density_apply, map_smul, mark_gauss,smul_mul_assoc]
-- relation at point equality of entire functions. No spectators yet.
local notation "δ"=> ((R.m a:ℂ)-(R.m b:ℂ))
theorem vectorWard : mark false y R.density - mark true y R.density = R.density*(δ • scalarProbe a b u 1+∑ v:Site c,current R a b u v):=by
     ext1 i; rw [ContinuousMap.sub_apply,ContinuousMap.mul_apply,ContinuousMap.add_apply,ContinuousMap.sum_apply,ContinuousMap.smul_apply]; change applyMark _ y _-applyMark _ y _=_; simp_rw [probe_bare]; rw [← mul_sub]; simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte]; apply congr_arg; rw [← form_sub]; change _= _ + ∑ v:Site c,couples _ (jets R a b u v i)
     rw [← map_sum, diverge]; rw [show R.D i*y-y*R.D i = δ • y+ (K i*y-y*K i) by rw [lay_left,lay_right,sub_smul]; abel,form_add, form_smul]; rfl
-- axial sum, no misleading Wilson cancellation. spin violation remains.
noncomputable def axial_rest(X:Spike): Insertion c F:= ⟨fun i=> form (K i*localF u X a b+localF u X a b*K i),by apply (couples _).continuous_of_finiteDimensional.comp (f:=fun i=> K i*localF u X a b+localF u X a b*K i); have hh:=leanD_cont R; fun_prop⟩
theorem axialWard (X:Spike) : let p:=localF u X a b; mark false p R.density+mark true p R.density= R.density*((((R.m a:ℂ)+(R.m b:ℂ)):ℂ) • scalarProbe a b u X+ axial_rest R a b u X):=by
     intro p; ext1 i; unfold mark; simp only [ContinuousMap.add_apply,ContinuousMap.mul_apply,ContinuousMap.smul_apply,stroll_at,probe_bare,Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte]; rw [←mul_add]; apply congr_arg; rw [← form_add]; rw [show R.D i*p+p*R.D i=((R.m a:ℂ)+(R.m b:ℂ)) • p+(K i*p+p*K i) from ?_,form_add, form_smul]; rfl
     unfold p; rw [lay_left,lay_right,add_smul]; abel
end YM.Massive.PCAC
#print axioms YM.Massive.PCAC.vectorWard

lemma focus_slot (i j:Modes c F)(he:i.1.1≠u) : localF u X a b i j=0 ∧ localF u X a b j i=0:=⟨focusL a b u X _ _ he,focusR a b u X _ _ he⟩
lemma mark_site (D: Set (Site c))(he:u∉D)(y:Stud c F)(hv: Uses D y)(g: Bool)(U:Grid c): applyMark g (localF u X a b) (y U)= 0:=by
    let Z:=localF u X a b; obtain ⟨p,hp⟩:= hv.2 U; rw [hp]; let V:=pass (RP.setDay D) p
    have hh(i:Modes c F)(hk:i.1.1=u): vary (.inl i) V=0∧vary (.inr i) V=0:=by

let f(u:Site c)(i j:Modes c F): Fields c F:= localF u X a b i j • gen (.inl i) (.inl j) (y U); change (∑ p,∑ i,∑ j,f p i j)=∑ i,∑ j,∑ p,f p i j; rw [sum_comm]; apply sum_congr rfl; intro _ _; rw [sum_comm]
    simp only [applyMark,LinearMap.sum_apply,LinearMap.smul_apply,Matrix.sum_apply,↓reduceIte,sum_smul]; rw [sum_comm]; apply sum_congr rfl; intro _ _; rw [sum_comm]
end YM.Massive.PCAC
#print axioms YM.Massive.PCAC.clears

local notation "V"=> film X a b A false
omit h in
lemma started : vectorDiff a b 1 A N=A.regulator.density*scalarWard a b A.regulator:=by rw [full_vector]; unfold vectorDiff film; rw [show actor A N=A.regulator.density from DFunLike.coe_injective ((act A hp le_rfl).trans hp.start)]
theorem passport (q:ℕ)(hx:q≤N): ∃ M:∀ i:ℕ, Deck (S.side R i) F,
     M q=0 ∧ (∀ i<q,M i=liftM A X a b i (M (i+1))) ∧ ∀ i≤q, (∀ b:Bool,s' q i (if b then T q else V q)=(if b then T i else V i)- passenger (M i)) ∧ s' q i (δc q)=δc i ∧ s' q i (εc q)= εc i - (2:ℂ) • passenger (M i):=by
     obtain ⟨M,hM,hm,H⟩:= deliver X a b A false hp h q hx; obtain ⟨V0,hV,hv,W⟩:= deliver X a b A true hp h q hx; have he(i:ℕ)(hi:i≤q): M i=V0 i:=by
         induction hi using Nat.decreasingInduction with
         | self=> rw [hM,hV]
         | of_succ i hi ih=> rw [hm i hi, hv i hi,ih]
     refine ⟨M,hM,hm,fun i hi=> ?_⟩; have h1:= H i hi; have h2:= W i hi; change s' q i _= _ at h1 h2; rw [←he i hi] at h2; refine ⟨fun b=>by cases b; exact h1; exact h2,?_⟩; unfold vectorDiff axialSum; rw [map_sub,h1,h2,map_add,h1,h2]; constructor <;> try rw [two_smul]
     all_goals abel
-- Projection on total axial sum: exposes precisely where additional probe estimate needed!
theorem charge (hX:X*Y=1)(hY:Y*X=1)(q:ℕ)(hx:q ≤ N)(i:ℕ)(hi:i≤q):
     chord Y a b A i (s' q i (δc q))= A.massRead i a - A.massRead i b ∧
     ∃ M:∀ i:ℕ, Deck (S.side R i) F, M q=0 ∧ (∀ i<q,M i=liftM A X a b i (M (i+1))) ∧ chord Y a b A i (s' q i (εc q))= A.massRead i a + A.massRead i b- 2* chord Y a b A i (passenger (M i)):=by
     obtain ⟨M,hM,h1,hL⟩:= passport a b X A hp h q hx; obtain ⟨-,hv,hw⟩:=hL i hi
     rw [hv]; constructor
     · unfold vectorDiff; rw [chord_sub, answering X Y a b A false hX hY i (hi.trans hx) hp, answering X Y a b A true hX hY i (hi.trans hx) hp]; simp
     refine ⟨M,hM,h1,?_⟩; rw [hw]; unfold axialSum; rw [two_smul,chord_sub,chord_add,chord_add, answering X Y a b A false hX hY i (hi.trans hx) hp, answering X Y a b A true hX hY i (hi.trans hx) hp]; simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte]; ring

-- Exact probe without scalar/quark normalization assumptions.
theorem reference (i:ℕ)(hx:i ≤ N): chord 1 a b A i (s' N i (A.regulator.density * scalarWard a b A.regulator))= A.massRead i a-A.massRead i b:=by
     rw [← started]; exact (charge a b 1 1 A hp h (by simp) (by simp) N le_rfl i hx).1; exact hp
end path

import YM.Massive.PCAC.Sum
import YM.Massive.Jasper.Source
/-!
# Test consequence at fixed reference for the actual massive trajectories

Full bare scalar-meson Ward operation in the differentiation convention here
(in bare spacing units, uses *bare* mass difference BEFORE the emissions),
all the way through any number of cuts. Significant off-diagonal
susceptibility actually advances to the difference of `massRead` at the
reference; as a limit as momentum tends toward zero wave, including interacting
unmasked history, thus NONDEGENERATE. This is progress on relating the mass
signal to PCAC, not yet a physical field theorem. No normalization taken from
expecting nonvanishing in the *physical* quotient.

Also specifies exactly where instead the axial-sum measurement value would
need a *contact estimate* to transfer. Do not claim it (may be tested from
much shorter q windows than going all the way to depth N).
-/

lemma one_step (m:ℕ)(hi:m<N)(w r v A:ℝ)(hx:a≠b)(he:T.Actual)(hZ:LocalPrice (T.density m) w r)(hM:∀ i, ‖T.massRead m i‖≤v)(hV:2*beamSize r≤ amount (S.side R m)*(A-v))(hT:1/2≤ T.w m):
      ‖chord g₅ a b T m (S.toStop R T.β T.w (m+1) m (axialSum a b g₅ T (m+1))) - (T.massRead m a+T.massRead m b)‖ ≤ 8* (productTariff g₅ *A^2+quartic g₅*w) :=by
    obtain ⟨M,hH,hU,hR⟩:=(PCAC.charge a b g₅ g₅ T he hx g5_sq g5_sq (m+1) hi m (by omega)).2; have hq:= hU m (by omega); let t:= T.w m; let s:ℂ:= (t:ℂ)⁻¹^2; let F0:= actor T m; let E:= flavorW g₅ a b (S.side R m)
    rw [show passenger (M m)= s • stroll (lap E) F0 from ?_] at hR; swap
    · rw [hq,hH]; unfold liftM toward; rw [quiltZero,add_zero,pax_scale,bore_at]
    rw [hR,chord_scale]; simp only [smul_eq_mul]; rw [show _-(T.massRead m a+T.massRead m b)= -(2*(s*chord g₅ a b T m (stroll (lap E) F0))) from by abel, norm_neg,norm_mul,norm_mul]; have hh: ‖chord g₅ a b T m (stroll (lap E) F0)‖ ≤ productTariff g₅*A^2+quartic g₅*w:=by unfold chord; rw [stroll_at,show F0 1=_ from congr_fun (act T he hi.le) 1]; exact width a b g₅ T m w r v A hZ hx hM hV
    have hs: ‖s‖ ≤4:=by
         unfold s; rw [norm_pow,norm_inv,Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (show 0 ≤ t from (he.w_pos hi).le)]; have hx: t⁻¹ ≤2 := by rw [← one_div]; apply (div_le_iff₀ (he.w_pos hi)).mpr; linarith only [show 1/2≤t from hT]
         nlinarith only [hx,inv_nonneg.mpr (show 0≤t from (he.w_pos hi).le)]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul hs hh (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num)) (norm_nonneg _)).trans_eq (by norm_num; ring)
end Brave
end YM.Massive.PCAC

#print axioms YM.Massive.PCAC.Brave.one_step

noncomputable abbrev μν (p q:Flavor 6)(r: Flavor 6→ℝ)(s:Bool):= r (if s then q else p)

noncomputable abbrev markK(p q:Flavor 6)(g:Bool)(R:Flavor 6→ℝ):ℝ:= if g then R p+R q else R p-R q
structure Honors (Q:Choir)(p q:Flavor 6)(g:Bool)(R: Flavor 6→ℝ)(u:ℝ) (c:ℂ):Prop where
     nonzero : lever p q g Q≠0
     room : lever p q g Q ∈ Q.level 6
     stars : aimV p q g Q=c • lever p q g Q
     fee : ‖c- (markK p q g R:ℂ)‖ ≤ u

      have hμ:∀ s,‖(μν p q R s:ℂ)‖ ≤μ:=fun s=>by rw[Complex.norm_real]; exact hA s
      obtain ⟨h1,h2,w,hW,hV⟩:= signalR T p q g h8 h6 hf8 hf6 H hp C1p X1 Y1 hh δ hδ hv (μν p q R) μ X hX hμ hD
      refine ⟨w,h1,h2,(armp p q g (Q:=Q)).trans hW,?_⟩; have he : (markK p q g R:ℂ) = (vP false:ℂ)+poli g * (vP true:ℂ):=by cases g<;>simp [markK,μν,poli] <;> ring

     let F:=equip T Φ K; refine ⟨hX.realA,hX.realB,fun i j h=>?_⟩
     obtain ⟨A,B⟩:=hX.power i j h
     have h1: MassM.axial F i j=axisP i j true Q:=rfl
     have h2: MassM.polar F i j=axisP i j false Q:=by ext a; change _= Q.focus _ _ (mesonCode _ _ _ (claw false a) _); rw [show claw false a=Lat.gamma a from mul_one (Lat.gamma a)]; rfl
     have h3: MassM.pseudo F i j=lever i j true Q:=rfl; have h4:MassM.scalar F i j=lever i j false Q:=rfl
     have hA: divergence F (MassM.axial F i j)=(S.axial i j:ℂ) • MassM.pseudo F i j:=A.divers
     have hV: divergence F (MassM.polar F i j)=(S.polar i j:ℂ) • MassM.scalar F i j:= by rw[h2]; exact B.divers
     have hp:= (add_pos (hM.positive i) (hM.positive j)).ne'
     have hd:= sub_ne_zero.mpr (hM.distinct.ne h)
     refine ⟨A.nonzero,?_,A.other,B.other,A.room,B.room,hv _ _ true h,?_,hh _ _ true h,hh _ _ false h,hA,hV,?_,?_⟩ -- VS field.V equality transport
     · intro a; change MassM.polar F i j a≠0; rw[h2]; exact B.nonzero a
     · change properVector F _; rw[h2]; exact hv i j false h
     · change divergence F _=_; rw [hA,Signals.renP,smul_smul,← Complex.ofReal_mul,show (S.bMass i+S.bMass j)*(S.axial i j/(S.bMass i+S.bMass j))=S.axial i j from by field_simp]
     · change divergence F _=_; rw[hV,Signals.renS,smul_smul,← Complex.ofReal_mul,show (S.bMass i-S.bMass j)*(S.polar i j/(S.bMass i-S.bMass j))=S.polar i j from by field_simp]
